_comment: Default engine settings. Per-project user overrides are stored in data/projects/<id>/overrides.json and every change is written to the audit log.

measurement._column_height_basis_options: to_slab_soffit = level(top) - level(base) - slab thickness at top; floor_to_floor = level(top) - level(base)
measurement._beam_depth_basis_options: below_slab = deduct slab thickness from overall depth where the family's depth includes the slab; full_depth = no deduction

ai._note: AI is optional and never used for measurements. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and enable to get natural-language explanations.
